Arcade._comment: The arcade lobby at the stations: a party, race or battle waits JoinSeconds for players; a station left choosing IdleSeconds goes back to 'press any button'. HeroPhotos: the photo step after choosing a hero (PhotoSeconds from its start to the photo).

Dungeon._lives: Lives: each downing costs one; downed on the last, a player is out (in a party they sit out). Everyone out: Continue?, and a swipe brings everyone back with all their lives. 0 = no limit.

Classes._comment: Each hero class's basic stats, as shares of the normal numbers (1 = normal): Hp of Game:Dungeon:AdventurerHp (100), DamageDealt of a right answer's damage (20 / 30 / 40 by difficulty, before crits and combos), DamageTaken of a monster's hit. Each class's power has its own numbers here too (see Core/Dungeon/ClassSettings.cs), e.g. "RogueCritMultiplier": 2.5. Applies from the next match.

Rewards._comment: Floor rewards: answer at least Accuracy of a floor's questions right (0.8 = 80%) and, after its boss, pick one of Choices rewards with the answer buttons (PickSeconds to choose, then one is picked for you). What each gives: HpBonus (share of starting max HP, plus a full heal), DamageBonus, ArmorBonus (share less damage), TimeSeconds, FastSeconds; Mastery raises the class's own power (RogueCrit, TankArmor, HealerHeal, WizardSplash, PugilistComboStep, WarlockReveal, RangerPeek). See Core/Dungeon/RewardSettings.cs. Run DungeonPacingTests after changing these.

Minigames._comment: Mini games between two rooms of a floor (how often: MinigameChance in config/dungeon.json; at most one per floor). Everyone in the party plays their own go; the arcade clock stops meanwhile. IntroSeconds (what it is, 3-2-1), ResultSeconds (how it went), WinEarnsReward (a pick of the floor rewards). RuneLock: stop the needle on the glowing mark Hits times in a row within Seconds (the mark gets MarkShrinkPerHit narrower with each hit); a miss starts again and locks the buttons for LockoutSeconds. See Core/Dungeon/Minigames/MinigameSettings.cs.

Dungeon._comment: Placeholder 8-bit effects made for the battle beats; replace the files (or point these at new ones) when real sounds exist.

Audio._BossMusic: Dungeon: the room music while anyone fights a boss. Empty = the playing music carries on.
